title: Another question opens a hopeful combination

captions.energy: Combining a wish with real possibility

meaning: You can ask differently and combine a wish to talk with a real possibility, preserving hope without promising to realise everything immediately.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Hanged Man in the physical position appears in pausing and changing a ready answer’s perspective. Temperance in energy encourages combining a wish to talk with real possibility rather than cancel either for the other. The Star in emotions brings hope for continuation. You can see more than a choice between the complete conversation now and total refusal: another question opens room for a combination still needing discussion.

For example, you wanted to describe impressions of a performance in detail, but very little time remains today. Pausing “Then we will not talk at all”, you ask whether one important thought could come now and the rest separately. **Hope can rest on a manageable beginning**. You discuss the option without demanding the entire next exchange be arranged immediately. The perspective stays alive because the wish is heard and conditions named. A small beginning need neither contain every impression nor make it less significant.

An encouraging combination becomes compulsory if it is expected to mean constant readiness for brief conversation under any conditions. Another perspective then merely changes pressure’s form: at least a little talk is still required. Constructive Temperance helps account for the genuine answers of you both. You can offer a manageable opening and hear that even this does not suit the present moment; hope need not prove itself through immediate conversation of any length.
